title: Readiness assessment
pitch: Show what passed, what needs attention, and where to start in one static dashboard.
makeItYours: Replace the fixed check results with your own in-memory assessment results and update the summary counts.
Change the area scores and warning thresholds to match your readiness criteria.
Replace the next-action sentence with a concrete response to your highest-priority finding.
useCase: Use it when a readiness review needs clear pass, warning and failure results.
